decisions.reason: Omitting the dedicated INA monitor does not change the established AXP2101 power-source, charging, rail, or battery-efficiency requirements. The freelancer's uncertain statement does not establish a new AXP2101 monitoring attribute.

The source decision concerns dedicated INA monitoring on the integrated-board design and does not change the standalone USB regulator, source-selection behavior, or powered loads of the separate-board variant.
Removing the dedicated INA monitor does not alter DCDC1 voltage, current rating, rail role, or Schottky-drop compensation.

The integrated-board architecture remains valid, and omitting a dedicated INA does not necessarily change the stated goal of retaining functionality because the monitoring function may be handled without that component.
The INA omission does not change the MT3608 converter, GPIO-controlled enable behavior, 5V sensor loads, or operating pattern.
The dedicated current-monitoring component is unrelated to the panel button connector and AXP2101 PWRON interface.
The source decision does not affect the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, mounting access, or unresolved pin order.
Omitting the INA monitor does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or protection requirements.
The source decision does not affect the charge-status LED path, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The INA omission does not alter ESP32 clocking, sleep policy, deep-sleep conditions, or wake sources.
The AXP2101 remains part of the design, and removing the separate INA monitor does not change its underside thermal-pad requirement.
The dedicated INA monitoring decision does not change LED supply voltage, data drive, level shifting, power control, or selected LED part.
